baseline_prompt_en: Create a single full-body editorial photograph built around an independently invented 1930s luxury-train marquetry atelier concept. One clearly adult woman whose facial appearance is guided by the attached portrait works inside a restored walnut-and-brass dining car, surrounded by veneer fans, shellac jars, hand planes, cotton polishing cloths, and a sunburst panel on a compact easel. Fully and opaquely dressed in a high-neck teal cotton blouse, charcoal wool trousers, a long leather apron, and closed oxford shoes, she pauses mid-restoration to inspect a burnished sunburst veneer panel. She visibly realizes a perched edge-sit with grounded support, crossed ankles forming a narrow believable base, and a relaxed wrist offset: her pelvis rests on the front edge of a sturdy leather tool chest, her torso balances upright, both shoes remain fully visible and contact the parquet, and her free forearm rests lightly along one thigh while its wrist falls softly outward with loose fingers. Frame head to toe at eye level, with warm task-lamp pools, cool dawn window light, crisp material texture, and unobstructed pose geometry.
